name: Scan Projects Limited
about: Scan Projects Limited provides engineering services in India and Nepal. It operates in two segments, Erection, Commissioning, Supervision and Annual Maintenance Contract; and Trading Activities. The company offers engineering services for erection, commissioning, and supervision of custom designed and engineered equipment and systems to the cement, fertilizer, and renewal power energy industries. It also trades in fabricating materials, machinery parts, and other items. The company was formerly known as Ambala Cements Limited and changed its name to Scan Projects Limited in December 2010. Scan Projects Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Yamuna Nagar, India.
